en: A colorized historic postcard view of a hilltop complex overlooking a town with red-roofed houses and a river valley in the background. Dominating the scene is a large Gothic cathedral with twin towers and adjacent castle-like buildings, all surrounded by greenery and old fortification walls. At the top left, printed in red script, is a caption identifying the location, and there is a small handwritten red inscription at the top right.
